invariants.rationale: The method is expected to return a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata or throw, as bulkInsert should not produce null.
The getWriteStatuses method should return a non-null list as per typical contracts of metadata objects.
A List's size is always non-negative, capturing a property of the returned metadata's write status list.
This relational property always holds for any Java List.
This is a property of Java Lists: if isEmpty is false, then size must be greater than 0, otherwise size==0.
